name: Cribbage
tagline: Fifteen two, fifteen four… peg your way around the board to 121.
rulesSummary: Everyone puts cards in the dealer's crib, then the deck is cut for a starter (a jack gives the dealer 2).
Pegging: take turns playing, keeping a running count up to 31. Score 15s and 31s (2), pairs (2/6/12) and runs.
Can't play without passing 31? Say Go. The last player to play scores 1 (2 for exactly 31), then the count restarts.
The show: each hand counts with the starter — fifteens 2 each, pairs, runs, flushes, and nobs (the jack of the starter's suit).
The dealer then counts the crib. First to 121 wins, even mid-hand.
